output.summary: An annual legume cultivated for its edible seeds, the chickpea has small feathery leaves and white flowers with blue, violet or pink veins. Its protein-rich seeds are central to foods such as hummus, falafel, curries, soups and stews.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds are eaten cooked, ground into flour or made into dishes such as hummus and falafel; young leaves are sometimes cooked as greens.
